text.plain: Furry new members of the family, maybe
Like the graphics of the original Super Mario Bros.
Like British humor vis-à-vis American humor, stereotypically
Rings in the New Year, perhaps
Operating system developed at Bell Labs
"Swallowed gum stays in your body for seven years," e.g.
Candy with the slogan "Two is more than one"
